integrity: The claims have a complete symbolic proof and a separate exhaustive small-instance arithmetic checker. Priority was assessed by actual literature and mathematical-record comparisons; independent external validation has not been conducted.
limitations: Unweighted friendship graphs of triangular petals; strict unilateral Nash deviations; self-inclusive fractional coalition denominators; coalitions need not induce connected subgraphs. No general-block-graph or modified-fractional game assertion.
title: Nash stability and the restricted-Bell spectrum of friendship networks
